d: Home is where the heart is a place to welcome friends and gather families full of warm memories and good times.
These Deadly Women have a dangerous charm. The men who meet them, love them in an instant.
Motherhood isn’t easy. And some women can’t cope with the responsibilities of raising a child.
Not every woman’s heart is filled with love and light. Deadly Women often carry much darker desires within.
Why did respectable suburban housewives Socorro, Robin and Marybeth kill their own children? Meet the women who murdered those who loved them the most.
Why did 17 year old Heather attack her mother with a hammer? How did privileged daughter Elizabeth convince her boyfriend to murder her wealthy parents.
In the early 1900s, Martha Rendell was hanged for torturing and murdering her husband's children. A look at the events that prompted her to commit such unspeakable acts of violence.
Alice Mitchell murders her lover after their relationship is forbidden; Susan Wright murders her adulterous husband; Larissa Schuster dissolves her husband's body in a barrel of acid.

These baby-faced girls may look childish and innocent, but behind their little girlsmiles lies and darkness most adults never experience. When their inner turmoilbubbles to the surface, they become unlikely criminals/ They become ‘Baby-facedKillers’.
A drug binge sends two women on a killing spree and a wife finds divorce more shameful than murder. Also, finding out why a gangster's wife would turn on her own family.
These women burn madly with hate. An anger so deep they’ll kill to satisfy it.What makes them turn on the one they love? Find out as we explore the reason’sfor a ‘Lover’s Revenge’.
Manipulative Patricia convinces her son to murder his step-father and Jean lures an old man to his death. Plus, how did Valerie punish her abusive husband.

In Texas, glamourous mother Darlie reports a vicious intruder attack that has left two of her young sons dead. When detectives begin their investigation, there are suspicions about how true her story is.
Crips gang leader Christina and her crew murder a young woman in a ritualistic initiation ceremony. Plus, a wife pushes her sadistic sexual fantasies to the limit.
Discovering why Sunday school teacher Melissa raped and killed her neighbour's little daughter and how Tiffany persuaded her lover to bury an elderly couple alive.
How did Queen Poisoner Lydia murder three husbands and seven children; why did granny Velma slaughter her husbands and friends; and did Paula kill her daughters.
An exploration of why bank robber Marjorie kills a pizza delivery boy with a pipe bomb; why Kim strangles a couple to death instead of paying back the $300 she owes them.
An examination of what prompts Amber to shoot her husband in the head; how Kate disposes of her elderly employer's body; why Wendi murdered her terminally ill husband.
What happens when a bride loves money more than her groom? Discover how Josephine convinced her lovers to commit murder and why con artist Elisa poisoned her husband.

Love is a powerful emotion, it can drive women to unthinkable crimes of passion. Hatehowever, is loves gloomy shadow, and it too can drive women into the darkness of theirminds where a callous plot to kill is hatched. These Deadly Women, once a vision in white,become their husbands blackest hour when murder is their escape from an ‘InconvenientMarriage’.
